name: EXAONE API Platform
description: LG AI Research offers its K-EXAONE 2.5 API free, with daily rate limits.
overview: LG AI Research makes K-EXAONE 2.5 available at no cost for service development and research with an API key. The Korean and English text model is available through an OpenAI-compatible API. Limits apply per second, minute and day; the documentation's numeric headers are examples, not a promised quota. Optional consent to usage-data analysis for training and service improvement increases the daily limit, but is not required to use the service.
